name: Suspected ectopic pregnancy (positive pregnancy test with pelvic pain/bleeding)
action: Emergency referral for urgent beta-hCG and pelvic ultrasound

name: Any bleeding occurring after confirmed menopause
action: Urgent 2-week-wait gynecology referral to rule out endometrial malignancy

name: Persistent bleeding, unexplained weight loss, or palpable pelvic mass
Fever, severe pelvic pain, and tachycardia suggestive of PID with sepsis
action: Same-day urgent assessment; consider IV antibiotics and admission

name: Sudden severe unilateral pelvic pain with nausea/vomiting
Rapid-onset virilization (voice deepening, clitoromegaly, rapid hair growth progression)
action: Urgent endocrinology referral to rule out androgen-secreting tumor

name: Precocious puberty with headache, visual disturbance, or rapid tempo
action: Urgent pediatric endocrinology referral; consider MRI brain

name: Heavy bleeding with dizziness, pallor, breathlessness, or tachycardia
action: Urgent referral for hemoglobin check and possible transfusion

name: Galactorrhea with visual field defect or persistent severe headache
action: Urgent MRI pituitary and endocrinology referral

name: Rapidly progressive Cushingoid features with new hypertension
Genital symptoms in a child/adolescent raising safeguarding concern
action: Safeguarding referral per local child-protection protocol

name: No breast development by age 13, or no menarche by age 15
Known/suspected Turner syndrome with cardiac symptoms or murmur
action: Cardiology referral for echocardiogram (coarctation/aortic root risk)

name: Infertility work-up patient presenting with acute pelvic pain
action: Urgent gynecology assessment to exclude ectopic pregnancy or torsion
